title: Laptop is slow after Windows 11 update
content:
Problem: Laptop is slow after Windows 11 update on Windows 10. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Installed pending driver updates and repaired Windows update components.

title: Computer repeatedly restarts after Windows update
content:
Problem: Computer repeatedly restarts after Windows update on Windows 11. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Installed pending driver updates and repaired Windows update components.

title: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access
content:
Problem: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access on macOS. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

title: Approved software cannot be installed on laptop
content:
Problem: Approved software cannot be installed on laptop on Windows 10. This started this morning.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Used the approved installer with administrator permission.

title: Remote access VPN drops after login
content:
Problem: Remote access VPN drops after login on Ubuntu. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.
